title: Payment API database connection timeout
symptoms: Payment requests are failing with 500 errors. Database connection timeout. Connection pool exhausted.
logs:
ERROR PaymentService: database connection timeout
ERROR ConnectionPool: unable to acquire connection
HTTP 500 POST /api/payment
Connection pool exhausted
failed_actions: Repeated application restarts did not resolve the database connection issue.
successful_fix: Increased the database connection pool and restarted the affected service.
recent_change: Database connection pool configuration was changed during the latest deployment.

title: Passengers charged but tickets not generated
symptoms: Passengers are successfully charged, but ticket confirmations are delayed or missing. Some users receive duplicate payment notifications.
logs:
ERROR BookingService: ticket generation timeout
ERROR PaymentService: payment completed successfully
WARN BookingQueue: message processing delayed
ERROR BookingService: booking confirmation not received
WARN QueueConsumer: retry limit reached
root_cause: Booking messages were stuck between the payment service and booking queue.
failed_actions: Restarting the Booking API did not resolve the issue.
successful_fix: Reprocessed the booking queue and corrected the payment gateway configuration.
recent_change: New payment gateway integration was deployed.

title: Users unable to login after deployment
symptoms: Users are unable to login. Authentication requests return 401 errors. Token validation is failing.
logs:
ERROR AuthService: invalid token signature
ERROR JWT: signature verification failed
HTTP 401 POST /api/login
WARN Authentication middleware rejected request
root_cause: Authentication signing configuration became inconsistent after deployment.
failed_actions: Restarting the authentication service did not resolve the invalid token signature errors.
successful_fix: Rolled back the authentication deployment and regenerated the signing configuration.
recent_change: A new authentication service version was deployed.

title: Redis cache timeout causing slow API responses
symptoms: API requests are taking longer than normal. Redis requests are timing out and cache hit rate dropped.
logs:
ERROR RedisClient: connection timeout
WARN CacheService: Redis unavailable
WARN API latency exceeded threshold
ERROR RedisPool: unable to acquire connection
root_cause: Redis connection pool reached its configured limit.
failed_actions: Restarting the API did not resolve the Redis timeout.
successful_fix: Increased the Redis connection pool limit and restarted the affected workers.
recent_change: Traffic increased significantly after the latest release.
